ops.body: Root review of reposync mapper proposal (not an implementation finding): avoid introducing silent scope cuts into Complete WIP. In particular, the primary monorepo uses Git LFS; detecting any LFS usage must not make every otherwise ordinary code checkpoint incomplete. Preserve changed raw working content and unpublished/staged LFS object dependencies where required; reuse/fetch published base assets under network policy. If a genuinely required object is unavailable, name it and retain the last complete checkpoint. Proposed fixed 100MiB/1GiB omissions must never yield a Ready checkpoint. Do not silently ship LFS pointers as the recovered content of unpublished edits. Also no arbitrary generated-file exclusions: tracked generated edits are WIP here.
